pkgmetadata.longdescription: Obscura is a VPN that tunnels WireGuard over QUIC through a two-party relay design. This package builds the Linux client from source: the obscura command-line tool, the obscura system service it drives (OpenRC init script always, systemd unit with USE=systemd), and optionally the GTK4/libadwaita desktop app that renders the web UI in WebKitGTK.

use.flag: Build the obscura-gui desktop application (GTK4, gui-libs/libadwaita, net-libs/webkit-gtk) and install its desktop entry, AppStream metadata and icons
